title: Connection damping + retry fallthrough runbook to reduce customer-facing 5xx/timeouts
creator: Ariana Patel
description: Multiple high-severity customer escalations reported bursts of 5xx and long-tail timeouts during tenant-heavy windows. Preliminary traces show a pattern where slow downstream worker/kv syncs cause connection stalls; client SDKs aggressively retry leading to request amplification and proxy queue saturation. This ticket implements a short-term, replay-safe mitigation (connection damping and a retry fallthrough policy) plus a validated runbook for SRE/SE to apply during escalations. Goals: 1) Stop amplification loops that convert single slow requests into multi-tenant error waves. 2) Provide an automated, observable soft-fail mode that keeps high-priority customer requests serving. 3) Ensure the fix is replay-safe for idempotent/non-idempotent paths and can roll out via feature flag/canary. Scope: edge proxy admission changes, retry-policy adjustments in SDKs, and a runbook with telemetry dashboards and drilldowns.
